name: Dr. Yuna Castell
lore: Yuna learned medicine where every clinic was also a barricade. She carries splints, bitter draughts, and the discipline to keep an expedition alive under siege.

abilities.name: Field Triage
abilities.text: Once per round, after you use Ember Sanctum Rest or Stabilize, heal 1 Wound.

abilities.name: Scar Ledger
abilities.text: After you complete a Contract, heal 1 Wound.

abilities.name: Siege Discipline
abilities.text: At the start of your turn, if you have at least 1 Wound, heal 1 Wound.

abilities.name: Amber Draught
abilities.text: Once per round, after you pass a Grit test, heal 1 Wound. Weakness: Field Triage cannot be used during battle.
